preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 2*10^5.
The number of edges in the graph is between n-1 and 2*10^5.
The vertices of each edge are numbered between 1 and n.
Each edge connects two distinct vertices.
The flow volume on each edge is between 1 and 10^4.
There is a path between any two vertices in the graph.
There is at least one valid way to direct the edges to satisfy the given conditions.

postconditions.expression: Output m lines, each containing one integer di.
postconditions.description: Each line contains the direction of the i-th edge, where di is 0 if the direction is ai -> bi and 1 if the direction is bi -> ai.

postconditions.expression: For each vertex v (1 < v < n), sum of ci of incoming edges is equal to the sum of ci of outcoming edges.
postconditions.description: The flow into each vertex must equal the flow out of each vertex, except for the source and sink.

postconditions.expression: Vertex with number 1 has no incoming edges.
postconditions.description: The source vertex (vertex 1) does not have any incoming edges.

postconditions.expression: The obtained directed graph does not have cycles.
postconditions.description: The directed graph formed by directing the edges according to the output must not contain any cycles.
